audit.whatIsWrong: Page called this a favoured 4/10 lane won 'from level 1', with Kennen holding six of seven chart rows.
audit.why: Kennen's own packet has 48.12% over 133 games. The mirror audit deferred siding because Sejuani's packet showed 63.83% over only 47 games; the 133-game figures reconcile exactly (48.12 + 51.88 = 100), so the 133-game number is the real one and this is a slightly losing lane.
audit.corrected: diff stays EVEN, diffRating 4/10 -> 6/10, tone to the even colour, chart re-sided to the packet: Skill / Kennen / Kennen / Sejuani / Kennen / Skill / Sejuani in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: First item was written as a straight Kennen spike; level 6 was scored Skill despite the text calling it a guaranteed stun-lock.
audit.why: Level 6 is Kennen's one window where a tank's armour does not matter. First item is genuinely a coin flip because she is buying raw HP against your burst. The two rows were the wrong way round.
audit.corrected: Level 6 -> Kennen, first item -> Skill, with the whys and phase text keyed to Arctic Assault's 18s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Slots are scrambled throughout: 'Permafrost slows', 'her percent-HP W', 'Permafrost percent-HP shred', 'her E (Arctic Assault) gap-close', 'her E (Winter's Wrath) stun', 'her W (Permafrost)', 'no dash until 3', and 'a full Permafrost shield'.
audit.why: Riot's kit: Q Arctic Assault is the 650-range charge that knocks up (available at level 1, 18s at rank 1); W Winter's Wrath is the double mace swing that slows and applies Frost stacks (9/8/7/6/5); E Permafrost stuns a target already at max Frost stacks and is only 1.5s; P Fury of the North is Frost Armor, giving Armor AND Magic Resist out of combat. No percent-HP shred and no shield appear anywhere in the text.
audit.corrected: Every slot renamed to Riot's names, the stun described as W-stacks-then-E, and the percent-HP and shield claims removed rather than restated.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Engage only on Permafrost's cooldown' was the page's core instruction.
audit.why: Permafrost is a 1.5s cooldown — it is effectively always up and its gate is Frost stacks, not time. The punishable cooldown is Arctic Assault at 18/16.5/15/13.5/12: once she has spent her charge she has no way to close 950 range.
audit.corrected: Cooldown tracking moved to Arctic Assault; Permafrost described by its stack requirement instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: Frost Armor's actual behaviour was never stated.
audit.why: Fury of the North grants Armor and Magic Resist only out of combat and persists briefly after she takes damage — so a single Q poke starts stripping it, which is why chip poke is better than waiting for one big trade.

edits.before: Sejuani has almost no early kill threat on you — her damage is percent-HP and CC, not burst, so the level 1-3 window is yours to poke. Throw Q (Thundering Shuriken) at her every time she steps to last-hit and let Electrical Surge on-hits add up; she has no dash but E (Arctic Assault) until 3, and her Frost Armor barely blunts your magic. The one thing to respect is her Permafrost passive — don't let her auto-stack you to the frost proc when you're stepping up, because that slow lets her chunk your retreat.
edits.after: Sejuani has almost no early kill threat on you — her damage is chip and CC, not burst, so the level 1-3 window is yours to poke. Throw Q (Thundering Shuriken) at her every time she steps to last-hit and let Electrical Surge on-hits add up; her one gap-closer is Arctic Assault (Q), 650 range on 18s, and Frost Armor's MR breaks the moment you damage her. The one thing to respect is Winter's Wrath stacking Frost on you — at max stacks Permafrost stuns, and that is how she chunks your retreat.

edits.before: Level 4-5 she gets sticky: with Permafrost slows and her W percent-HP shred, an immobile tank who can actually walk you down starts to flip short trades, so respect her step-ins and keep poking from range instead of dueling. Level 6 is your reset button — a clean Slicing Maelstrom into a triple-marked Sejuani stun-locks even a tank, so bait out her E (Arctic Assault) gap-close, then E-in and R for your only window where her armor and HP don't matter. Don't blow R into Frost Armor and a full Permafrost shield for nothing.
edits.after: Level 4-5 she gets sticky: Winter's Wrath slows on a 9s cooldown and fills Frost stacks until Permafrost stuns you, so a tank who can actually walk you down starts flipping short trades — poke from 950 instead of dueling. Level 6 is your reset button: a clean Slicing Maelstrom into a triple-marked Sejuani stun-locks even a tank, so bait out Arctic Assault (Q, 18s), then E-in and R for your one window where her armor and HP don't matter. Her charge stops on the first champion it hits, so it never carries her past you into a second target.

edits.before: This is where Sejuani takes the lane back hard. She builds full tank with Permafrost percent-HP shred that melts your squishy body, and her R (Glacial Prison) is a long-range hard CC that cancels your Slicing Maelstrom channel and your E-in the instant you commit. You cannot 1v1 her once she has two items, and in fights she peels you off her carries with E stun and ults you out of your own R. Win this on your 6 and first-item spike, then pivot to a teamfight engager and pick squishies from range — never sidelane into her.
edits.after: This is where Sejuani takes the lane back hard. She builds full tank, Winter's Wrath into a Permafrost stun pins your squishy body for her team, and her R (Glacial Prison) is a 1300-range hard CC that cancels your Slicing Maelstrom channel the instant you commit. You cannot 1v1 her once she has two items, and in fights she peels you off her carries with the E stun and ults you out of your own R. Win this on your 6 and first-item spike, then pivot to a teamfight engager — never sidelane into her.

notes: Sejuani's slots were scrambled across nine fields (Permafrost described as the slow, Winter's Wrath as the stun, Arctic Assault labelled E, plus an invented percent-HP shred and a 'Permafrost shield'). The whole page also told the reader to engage on Permafrost's cooldown, which is 1.5s — the real gate is Arctic Assault at 18s rank 1. Win rate resolved against the mirror's open question: 48.12% over 133 games for Kennen, 51.88% for Sejuani over the same 133, so the 47-game 63.83% figure in Sejuani's packet is the outlier. Chart re-sided to the packet in matched pairs.
